name: Ilias Kementzides
description: '''Ilias Kementzides''' (April 2, 1926 - November 11, 2006) was an American musician of [[Pontic Greeks|Pontian Greek]] descent. He both played and sang [[Pontic Greek music|Pontian Greek folk music]]. His main instrument was the [[Kemençe of the Black Sea|lyra]], which is a type of [[kemenche]]. In 1989, he received the [[National Heritage Fellowship]] for his folk music career.
